source_graph.range_separation: Paper target n>=3 and independently generalized n>=2 target remain distinct. No A1-n3-to-n2 entailment.

author_route.shape: AND: constant and coordinate Poisson representation evaluations at r e1, norm-square rewrite, division by1-r^2.

checked_astis_alternative.semantics: Explicit sufficient OR route for the same moments, not an attribution of this proof to the authors.

steps.title: Keep the actual law and positive denominator
steps.actual_correspondence: sphere_geometry, pole_excluded and subtype_moments derive positivity, the actual probability instance, continuity and h0/h1 L1. The canonical Haar/surface realization is already established in SphereHaar/SurfaceLaw; no probability or L1 hypothesis is added.

steps.title: Obtain the unweighted value by spherical mean value
steps.actual_correspondence: subtype_moments calls the existing poissonKernel_harmonicOnNhd and harmonic_closedBall_mean_value, then proves hden, hscale, hd and hI0. The full arbitrary-harmonic-function Poisson representation is not an input or a claimed output.

steps.title: Compute the actual shifted potential in both dimensions
steps.actual_correspondence: potentialProfile, potential and potentialCoefficient are literal private definitions. potential_data calls radial_gradient_laplacian and proves the log/power derivatives, actual C2, gradient and zero Laplacian. potential_harmonic gives neighborhood harmonicity, and potentialCoefficient_ne_zero proves cancellation is legal.

steps.title: Use a larger parent ball before transferring gradients
steps.actual_correspondence: subtype_moments proves hrR,hR1,hF, obtains v,hvu,hf from harmonic_closedBall_zero_flux, then uses isOpen_ball.mem_nhds and EventuallyEq.gradient_eq. hτflux and hμflux transfer the actual flux and its measure normalization.

steps.title: Read the weighted moment from zero flux
steps.actual_correspondence: sphere_geometry supplies the inner product; hpair, hz and hI1 perform the exact calculation using integral_sub only after h0/h1. Neither moment is assumed.

steps.title: Transport the values and integrability to the ambient law
steps.actual_correspondence: The public proof proves hσ by Measure.map_smul and uses MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe, integrable_map_iff and integral_map. This is a carrier adapter for the actual moments, not a second theorem credit.

steps.title: Consume both values in the selected numerator
steps.actual_correspondence: selected_numerator_value in Tests/GaussianComplexitySphericalPoisson.lean calls spherical_poisson_moments and SelectedTilt.selected_tilt, proves L1 for the linear combination and evaluates the exact numerator. The same focused test also exercises n=2 and n=3 at r=1/2.

checked_astis_alternative.critical_margin: Parent R=(1+r)/2; neighborhood EqOn in its open ball before gradient equality at r zeta. Boundary EqOn alone is not used.

actual_consumer.name: selected_numerator_value
actual_consumer.meaning: Actual L1 and integral of selected sphere numerator, immediately before Eq24. Not evaluated Gaussian Eq24.

postproof_review.boundary: The full Lean statement is stronger in dimension range than the conservative unambiguous raw-source intersection, so no full-statement equivalence is claimed. Raw A1 contains both n≥2 and a trailing n≥3; the full-statement source-fidelity verdict is source-underspecified. On the conservative source slice n≥3 and0<r<1, the actual conclusion is equivalent after carrier/positive-base elaboration. The n=2 case is separately accepted as an explicitly disclosed and independently proved ASTIS generalization; neither contradictory source clause has been repaired or overwritten.
